summary: ITER187.B Journey Mail Workspace Phase 1 UI tested end-to-end (frontend only, backend not retested). Login OK. Sidebar 'Mail' link routes to /communications/mail/mailboxes correctly (fix verified). All 4 mail routes (/communications/mail, /mailboxes, /messages, /compose) mount cm-mail-workspace. Empty states render (cm-empty-mailboxes, cm-msg-empty-pick, cm-compose-no-mailbox). Drawer opens with cm-mailbox-drawer, validation errors surface visually as 'Obbligatorio' labels on empty submit. Provider preset 'siteground' visibly prefills imap.siteground.com:993 + smtp.siteground.com:465 (confirmed via screenshot). 404 path /communications/mail/messages/<bad-id> renders cm-msg-detail-error. Compose page correctly shows cm-compose-no-mailbox empty state (no mailbox exists) and contains NO Tiptap / ProseMirror toolbar. Messages list page renders all 4 filters (mailbox/direction/period/search). Critical gaps found: (a) Communications tab missing on /workspace/projects/:id (existing project found but tab-communications testid not rendered); (b) several IMAP/SMTP host/port/username/smtp-password inputs lack data-testid attributes, preventing automated form fill and full mailbox-create POST verification.

ui_bugs.issue: IMAP/SMTP secondary fields (host, port, security, imap-username, smtp-host, smtp-port, smtp-username, smtp-password) DO render and DO get prefilled by provider preset visually (imap.siteground.com:993 / smtp.siteground.com:465 confirmed via screenshot), but they LACK data-testid attributes. Only cm-field-mailbox-name, cm-field-mailbox-type, cm-field-provider, cm-field-from-email, cm-field-imap-password, cm-field-visibility have testids. Spec calls for cm-field-imap-host / cm-field-smtp-host (used to verify preset). Add testids to all form inputs for testability.
ui_bugs.selector: cm-field-imap-host, cm-field-imap-port, cm-field-imap-username, cm-field-smtp-host, cm-field-smtp-port, cm-field-smtp-username, cm-field-smtp-password

ui_bugs.issue: Communications tab not found on /workspace/projects/:id. A real project exists (id 34968e0e-4587-4290-ab2a-ef3c4c7b198f) but [data-testid=tab-communications] count=0 after navigation. Either the tab is not rendered or the testid is missing/named differently. dj-comm-empty / dj-comm-tab-emails consequently not reachable via UI. Verify ProjectDetailPage.jsx actually mounts the Communications tab and exposes tab-communications testid.

integration_issues.issue: Could not complete a successful POST /api/journey-mail/mailboxes via UI automation because required SMTP password and IMAP/SMTP username fields lack data-testid (could not be filled programmatically). Manual screenshot shows form validation surfaces 'Obbligatoria' for these fields. Once testids are added, automated happy/error-path coverage can be completed. UI itself appears functionally correct (validation blocks submit when fields missing; toast/error layer not exercised).

Could not validate cm-msg-body-frame sandbox='' attribute end-to-end because there are 0 messages in the system (CRM empty post ITER174). The 404 path (/communications/mail/messages/<bad-id>) correctly renders cm-msg-detail-error. Recommend a manual check via React DevTools or once a real mailbox+message is seeded.

issues: Persistent top banner 'Setup workspace · 3/6 · Blueprint Chameleon™ · Scegli lo stile visivo che definisce lo studio' overlaps top of all pages (pre-existing, cosmetic).
Multiple console warnings 'Cannot update a component while rendering a different component' from LocalizationOverlay (pre-existing, not journey-mail related).

action_items: Add data-testid attributes to all IMAP/SMTP form inputs in MailboxFormDrawer.jsx (imap-host, imap-port, imap-username, smtp-host, smtp-port, smtp-username, smtp-password, security selects). Spec explicitly references cm-field-imap-host / cm-field-smtp-host for preset verification.

Verify Communications tab is actually registered on ProjectDetailPage.jsx with data-testid='tab-communications' — current test fails to locate it on a real project. Also expose dj-comm-tab-emails and dj-comm-empty inside that tab.

Once both above are fixed, retest: (1) full mailbox connect POST happy/sad path with metric cards (cm-metric-health-*, cm-metric-last-sync-*, cm-metric-total-*, cm-metric-linked-*), (2) Communications tab empty state on a project, (3) iframe sandbox='' attribute on a real message (seed minimum 1 mailbox + 1 message).
critical_code_review_comments: MailboxFormDrawer: provider preset wiring works (visual confirmation), but inconsistent data-testid coverage — half the form is testable, half is not. Should apply testids to every input/select for parity.
Compose page correctly renders <textarea> with NO Tiptap/ProseMirror dependencies (operational composer per Founder direction A2 — verified via DOM query). Good.
MessageDetailPage error state (cm-msg-detail-error) works correctly for unknown ID (Italian 'Caricamento messaggio fallito.'). Good.
Routing: All 4 main routes mount the workspace layout via Outlet correctly. No 404 surface issues.
Italian localization: All journey-mail UI strings are Italian (Mailbox connesse, Nessuna mailbox connessa, Connetti mailbox, etc.). Conformant to brief.
Multiple 403 errors observed in console during navigation — likely unrelated to journey-mail (other modules' permission checks). Should be investigated separately if user-visible.
test_credentials: admin@moodfordesign.com / Blueprint2024! (root superadmin, tenant studio) — from /app/memory/test_credentials.md
seed_data_creation: None. No mailbox could be successfully connected via UI (missing testids on required SMTP fields blocked programmatic fill). CRM remains empty as expected post ITER174.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Frontend journey-mail surface is mostly wired. PASS: sidebar-nav-mail, cm-mail-workspace, cm-empty-mailboxes, cm-mailbox-new-btn, cm-empty-connect-btn, cm-mailbox-drawer, cm-mailbox-submit (validation triggers visually), cm-field-provider (with options custom/siteground/gmail/outlook/exchange), provider preset prefills hosts visually, cm-msg-filter-mailbox/direction/period/search, cm-msg-empty-pick, cm-compose-no-mailbox, cm-msg-detail-error (404), 4 routes mount correctly, NO Tiptap on compose. FAIL/GAP: tab-communications testid not found on a real project page; cm-field-imap-host / cm-field-smtp-host / cm-field-imap-username / cm-field-smtp-host / cm-field-smtp-username / cm-field-smtp-password testids missing — add them and retest the full connect flow. Once a mailbox is connected, verify cm-msg-body-frame has sandbox='' (empty string) attribute on a real message detail page.
rca of the issue: Two distinct issues: (1) MailboxFormDrawer applied data-testid to only ~half the form fields; the IMAP/SMTP nested inputs (host/port/security/username, and SMTP password) were left without testids. Provider preset logic IS correct (preset values visible in screenshot after selecting siteground), so this is a pure testability gap, not a functional bug. (2) The Communications tab on ProjectDetailPage either is not yet rendered or uses a different testid than tab-communications — needs verification in /app/frontend/src/pages/workspace/ProjectDetailPage.jsx.
